competences.description: Attacks 2 times with a vampire bat and recovers HP by 30% of the inflicted damage.

effets.description: Heal that affects only the monster who cast the skill

competences.description: Ambushes the enemy to deal two strong blows and stuns the target for 1 turn with a 50% chance. This skill has 30% additional Critical Rate and will deal more damage according to your Attack Speed.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Removes all harmful effects granted on yourself at the start of your turn. Additionally, absorbs 10% HP each from all other allies when you're inflicted with fatal damage. HP can't be absorbed from allies that are at 30% HP or lower. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Heal that affects only the monster who cast the skill
effets.note: Absorbs from allies that have more than 30% HP
